claim_scope: Static/local audit of DPO negative near-miss quality evidence only. No training, runtime, build, host execution, external AI, or final completion claim.

evidence_sources.finding: CM-25 requires DPO negatives to be real near-misses: plausible, taxonomy-labelled, close enough to chosen outputs, and not generic refusal or absurd bad output.
PromptToTask and OrchestrationReasoning are mapped to their respective negative-strategy docs and DPO authoring skills.
PromptToTask strategy seed rows include PromptError codes, chosen/rejected refs, and plausible wrong-output descriptions.
OrchestrationReasoning strategy seed rows include ORCH error codes, chosen/rejected refs, and plausible wrong-output descriptions.
Overall DPO train readiness is false: both PromptToTask and OrchestrationReasoning still miss approved row-level error_code, chosen_ref, and rejected_ref values.
PromptToTask materialization is not ready because approved_prompt_pair_binding_ref, approved_error_code, approved_chosen_ref, and approved_rejected_ref are missing for metadata rows.
OrchestrationReasoning materialization is not ready because approved_pair_binding_ref, approved_error_code, approved_chosen_ref, and approved_rejected_ref are missing for 136 rows.

SkillSelection has universalization and trainable-unit evidence, but this audit did not find a dedicated SkillSelection negative near-miss strategy equivalent to the PromptToTask and OrchestrationReasoning strategy docs.

Adaptive SkillSelection correction DPO signals record chosen_ref and rejected_ref shapes for user-local learning, but this remains user/adaptive signal evidence rather than common train-ready DPO quality for all domains.

audit_rows.finding: PromptToTask has real strategy seed rows with PromptError taxonomy and plausible rejected outputs, but finalized metadata is train_ready=false because approved row-level bindings are missing.
OrchestrationReasoning has real strategy seed rows with ORCH taxonomy and plausible rejected outputs, but finalized metadata is train_ready=false because approved row-level bindings are missing.

audit_rows.area: SkillSelection universal skill semantics negative strategy quality
audit_rows.finding: SkillSelection has checkpoint-backed semantic-unit and universalization evidence, but no dedicated SkillSelection negative near-miss DPO strategy/template equivalent to PromptToTask and OrchestrationReasoning was found in this audit.
audit_rows.not_claimed: complete SkillSelection negative near-miss DPO quality

audit_rows.finding: Seed rows show plausible near-miss wrong outputs and taxonomy codes, but the train-ready gate still rejects them until approved row-level source bindings exist.
Available universalization artifacts separate universal reasoning/semantic payload from technical execution and preserve narrow claim scope.
audit_rows.not_claimed: technical execution DPO train-ready common model

audit_rows.finding: PromptToTask and OrchestrationReasoning use distinct strategy documents and error taxonomies. SkillSelection has distinct trainable semantic units, but lacks a dedicated negative near-miss strategy artifact in the current audit evidence.

audit_rows.area: Adaptive/user-side DPO generation from AI result/correction
audit_rows.finding: Adaptive signal writers and chosen/rejected refs exist, but the evidence remains user-local/adaptive and does not close common train-ready DPO quality for all three semantic domains.
audit_rows.not_claimed: common model trained from adaptive user corrections

audit_rows.area: Binding templates filled enough for execution
audit_rows.finding: Binding templates exist and explicitly avoid invented labels, but they are operator_approval_required and not filled enough for train-ready execution.

audit_rows.area: No generic refusal or absurd negative substitute
audit_rows.finding: Current seed evidence uses labelled near-miss error classes rather than generic refusal/empty/absurd negatives. The remaining issue is approval/binding completeness, not generic refusal substitution in the sampled seed rows.
audit_rows.not_claimed: full corpus-wide negative quality for every future row

first_actionable_gap.description: PromptToTask and OrchestrationReasoning DPO templates/finalized metadata are not train-ready because approved row-level error_code, chosen_ref, and rejected_ref bindings are missing.
